$comment: The engine benchmark's pinned inputs (FR-050-AC-30, CR-099; agent-ix/quire-rs#231). Metric dictionary first, corpora second — a metric that does not declare unit/population/method is not one this benchmark emits (agent-ix/quoin FR-043-AC-1).

authoring.tag_rate.population: evidence symbols the code walk examined
authoring.tag_rate.method: sum(binding_census.tagged) / sum(binding_census.candidates). Generic id-shaped tokens are counted independently of the declared grammar, so the metric separates authoring absence from unread authored tags

coverage.backed_pct.population: reference rows the declared model reconciles in the corpus entry
coverage.backed_pct.method: quire coverage --scope <entry>; backed / total. A partial read shows up as `matched` far below `examined` in the same payload (FR-063), which is why this is scored alongside binding_read_pct rather than alone

coverage.binding_read_pct.population: evidence symbols the code walk examined
coverage.binding_read_pct.method: sum(binding_census.bound) / sum(binding_census.candidates). THE PREMISE metric: 0% here made `555/2389 (23%)` arithmetic over nothing, and no coverage figure means anything while it is low

coverage.dead_tags.population: trace markers written in source across the corpus entry
coverage.dead_tags.method: count of untracked_symbols — a marker whose id no trace target ever minted. #72 measured 1,014 of these; the point of tracking it is that the number stops being silence

coverage.minting_repos.population: repositories walked in the corpus entry
coverage.minting_repos.method: repositories whose declared matrix paths carry a `## Test Case Summary` — the section the `test-case` target reads. #72 measured 153 of 237 minting ZERO; that zero becomes a tracked number rather than an absence nobody looks at

properties.specific_shaped_pct.population: binding acceptance criteria in the corpus entry
properties.specific_shaped_pct.method: totals.specific_shaped / totals.criteria — the honest half of the extractable headline (CR-095). Scored INSTEAD of the bare extractable figure, which reads as 54% where the specific figure is 8%

sentinel.silent_zero.population: metrics emitted across every corpus entry
sentinel.silent_zero.method: metrics with matched = 0 over a non-zero population and NO accompanying diagnostic. This is a GATE, not a score: expected exactly 0, no tolerance, no ratchet. It is the shape of the defect that made three published SpecReviews wrong

skeptic.suspicion_rate.population: evidence symbols the code walk examined in the corpus entry
skeptic.suspicion_rate.method: len(suspicions) / sum(binding_census.candidates). THE LANGUAGE-COVERAGE guard (CR-103): v0.44.0 shipped a vacuity detector whose Rust guard list read `=> {` as a match arm, which is an arrow function in TypeScript — 549 suspicions over 551 candidates on agent-ix/quoin, against 2 of 883 here. A rate near 100% is a rule misreading a language, not a corpus full of vacuous tests

corpora.name: specific-shape-control
corpora.$comment: The production coverage-envelope control for MP-205. The repository-scale entries may carry no binding criteria; this fixture guarantees the active plan is measured from a non-empty population rather than left permanently not_computed.

corpora.name: self
corpora.$comment: This repository, at whatever it is. Not pinned on purpose: it is the fast inner-loop entry and its job is to move as the engine does.

corpora.name: filament-ide-rs
corpora.$comment: The Phase 3 immutable filament corpus. PINNED with a full SHA: a run against a different revision is refused rather than scored, because a score that moves on an unpinned corpus says nothing about which change moved it (agent-ix/quoin FR-043-AC-8). The older answer-key snapshot remains recorded separately in the answer-key evidence.

corpora.name: quoin
corpora.$comment: TYPESCRIPT. Carried for language coverage, not for its coverage figures: this is the corpus that exposed CR-102's 549-of-551 misread, and no TypeScript tree was scored before it. Scored on the two gates only — its backed_pct moves whenever somebody writes a spec row, and ratcheting a tree this repository does not control would train everyone to run bench-update reflexively.

corpora.name: spec-artifacts-process
corpora.$comment: PYTHON. The corpus that exposed CR-102's hollow-denominator false positive: coverage.implements reads an honest 0 of 42 here and was reported as arithmetic over nothing, while this repository reads 15 of 1412 and could never have shown it. Same gate-only scoping as quoin.
